_doc: Stern's Shipyard 1F (Sapphire 21x15; zone 14, area 289). Office (cols 0-5, Sapphire's teal hexagon floor = the style floor) and workshop (cols 7-20, Sapphire's olive metal floor = floor_tex in77k_yuka1) separated by Sapphire's white partition at col 6 (rows 2-8 and 11-14: a 40-unit block, open at rows 9-10). Workshop furniture row along the back wall (row 1): consoles (8-10, 1) = Black 2 lab cabinets machine02/machine01, wall panels (13,1) (15,1) = monitor pictures in22_tv02/in22_tv04 (303). Doorway up (3,1) = Black 2's ship cabin door cabin_door (Royal Unova). Office: the ship-model counter (0-1, 2) = white counter shelf03; desks with PCs (0-1, 5/8/11) = shelf03 + monitor01 on top; Sapphire's drawing board (4-5, 6-7) = lab table table02; red stools = cushions chushion01. Workshop: Sapphire's big engine (11-14, 4-9) = Juniper's lab machines machine_l02 + machine_l01; the small machinery (9-10, 5-6) = machine01/machine02; orange lattice girders (7, 4-6) (10, 12) (14, 12) = thin lattice blocks (fac_girder); orange plank stacks (19-20, 4-6) (7-9, 12-14) (18-20, 11-13) = wood plank blocks (fac_planks). Blocks are terrain: a chunk holds at most 32 furniture placements (field_g3d_mapper.c: propCapacity1 = 0x20, and the game writes past the array without a check), so the stacks are not furniture. Sapphire's ceiling hooks (17,0) (20,0) have no Black 2 model: left out. Girders end 12 units north of the walkable tile in front of them (FRONT_H; walkability 2026-10-11).
